# Copilot Prompts

This directory contains AI and Copilot prompts for development assistance and code generation.

## Overview

Prompts help guide AI models and Copilot in generating code, documentation, and solutions aligned with your project's standards.

## Structure

```
prompts/
├── code-generation/
│   └── flutter-widget.md
├── documentation/
│   └── api-docs.md
├── testing/
│   └── unit-test-template.md
└── guidelines.md
```

## Prompt Categories

### Code Generation Prompts
- Flutter widgets
- Service classes
- Utility functions
- Data models

### Documentation Prompts
- API documentation
- README generation
- Code comments
- Architecture docs

### Testing Prompts
- Unit test templates
- Integration test patterns
- Test case generation
- Mock object creation

## Using Prompts

1. Reference prompts in IDE with Copilot extensions
2. Copy prompt templates for consistent AI-assisted development
3. Customize prompts for specific features or modules

## Best Practices

- Keep prompts specific and detailed
- Include context about your project
- Update prompts as standards evolve
- Document expected outputs
- Include examples when helpful

## Example Prompt

```
# Flutter Widget Prompt

Generate a Flutter widget for [COMPONENT_NAME] with:
- State management: [Provider/Bloc/Riverpod]
- Build method with proper structure
- Documentation comments
- Error handling

Follow the project's widget guidelines...
```
